summary: Empire activity on Home grows with the launcher window, so a bigger or fullscreen launcher shows more news at once.

changes.title: Empire activity fills a bigger window
points: When the launcher is taller, for example fullscreen, the Empire activity columns grow and show more news without scrolling.
Each column now loads up to 20 items instead of 6, so there is more to scroll through.

previous.summary: Client updates on the Home news now show when they were really released, instead of "just now".

changes.title: Update news shows the real release time
points: Each "Client update" in the Everyone news is dated by when it was actually published.
Updates that came out together with a later one show that release's time.
